description: Physics-derived RUL failure thresholds (04_ml_rul_mission_probe.md Sec 2.4). Computed via rul/failure_threshold_solver.py: binary search of each health parameter against a real Rotax 915iS operator's-manual limit (CHT/coolant, EGT, oil pressure) or a documented [ASSUMED] climb-power fraction where no real airframe-specific limit is available, at a 200-step (20s) equilibrated stress operating point.

0.limit_description: P_brake < 59.4kW ([ASSUMED] 60% of the real 99kW max-continuous anchor -- real MTOW climb-power requirement not available) at 5500rpm climb, ISA+20

operating_point.stress_scenario: Minimum power for required rate of climb at MTOW

1.limit_description: EGT > 950C (real Rotax EGT limit) at lean cruise, ISA+20

operating_point.stress_scenario: EGT (misfire/knock proxy) at leanest commanded cruise mixture

2.limit_description: CHT > 120C (real Rotax coolant limit) at 5500rpm climb, ISA+20

operating_point.stress_scenario: CHT/coolant limit at max continuous power in climb
